concerns.text: The fileSize (hardcoded to 245000) and fileType (hardcoded to 'application/pdf') in mapToResponse of DocumentController are hardcoded instead of reflecting the actual document metadata.

DocumentService.searchAndFilterDocuments performs in-memory filtering by parsing JSON metadata using objectMapper.readValue for every document in the subset. This can cause performance degradation as the database grows.
DocumentService.recordAuditLog uses UUID.randomUUID().toString() which introduces nondeterminism in ID generation and complicates testing and verification.
The synonym groups in DocumentService are hardcoded in a static list. This lacks flexibility and requires a code redeployment to modify or add synonyms.

DefaultEiosClient and NotificationService instantiate RestTemplate inline (new RestTemplate()). It is a best practice to inject RestTemplate or RestTemplateBuilder to allow proper configurations (e.g. timeouts, custom headers, logging).
The PR diff includes deleted build artifacts from the target/ directory. While removing them is the correct action, ensuring target/ is properly ignored prevents committing them in the first place.
